nom: Bubble Plus One Tinted Daily Mineral Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 40

avis.texte: I was using cerave tinted spf which was fine on its own but it left my skin sort of greasy and didnt blend well with my makeup, I found this product on clearance so I thought I would give it a try and I like it so much better. I was concerned that there was only one tint color but it is comparable to the "light" shade of cerave. It gives me a nice glow on its own and looks pretty under my foundation as well. I also like the packaging better than cerave which always leaks all over. I won't mind paying full price for this next time and I hope it stays available.
Felt too thick like a face cream. Not really hydrating either made my face feel a bit chalky. Not easily spreadable. Looks nice on the skin when applied no white cast.

Feels lightweight on the skin. Looks nice, dewy and doesn't pill. HOWEVER, if you have fair/light complexion this is NOT for you. Looked too orange on me. Do not buy if you are fair/ light complexion. You will look orange!!!

Got this in my free sample bag. Felt good and light at first until I went outside. I dont sweat very easily but once I had this on my face and was hit by sun I felt drenched in my sweat and itchy. Once i got to work i wiped it off and my sweat was gone so it was this product.
I would say it pulls a little orange but it is pretty sheer so it doesnt matter much for me. It is nice texture and i usually wear it on its own with concealer and it works well for me!
I've gone through so many bottles. I love the tint, theres no white cast. My eyes don't get watery when using this sunscreen. It's perfect for my sensitive skin.

I like this a lot. It's not heavy and I appreciate that it's unscented and doesn't clog pores. I would recommend it as an acne and budget friendly option for a tinted sunscreen. I use regular moisturizer with my skincare under this. Not sure how moisturizing it is on its own.

avis.titre: I have bought this product over and over again
avis.texte: This is a very good product. I have repurchased multiple times.

I bought this sunscreen after running out of my Drmtlgy tinted sunscreen and needing something between deliveries, and I'm so glad I did. It's just as good but less money, so to me, that makes it better. It's tinted, which is important for people prone to hyperpigmentation, but not dark, which is important for pale people like me. I was a little nervous about buying it at first because its description says it's mattifying, and I prefer dewy, but I didn't find that at all (but maybe I'm just oily enough that it's dewy on me!). Because it's not mattifying (again, on me; I can't speak to how it reacts with anybody else's skin), it doesn't settle into, or accentuate, fine lines. I actually find it does the opposite - deflect attention from the lines in my forehead. It also evens out my skin tone and gives me a nice glow - all without causing breakouts or little bumps under my skin, which I'm very prone to getting.

i have light skin with olive undertones and this made me look extremely orange when using the recommended amount. i also wouldn't recommend for oily skin, even with setting powder on top my skin was shiny. 3 stars because i can see it working better for someone with a deeper skin tone than mine, and because it does its job and i never got sunburnt while wearing it. even though i dont love it on its own, i kept it to use as a topper to counteract the white cast that my other sunscreen leaves

It is pretty greasy looking to me. I like the tint but this is for people who want that 'glow' look. It just makes me feel like I look sweaty. And when I did sweat and it ran into my eyes, it burned pretty badly.

With my type 2 Rosacea it's very hard to find a sunscreen that doesn't irritate my skin or cause breakouts. This sunscreen I have boughten multiple times and will continue to buy. The tint gives you a nice glow and blends very well, even on my pale winter skin. Everytime I switch to a different one, it doesn't work out so I have found my go-to sunscreen.

I ordered this after hearing great reviews. Received it in the mail and the pump was defective. Swapped it out in store for another one after me and the cashier confirmed it was broken and not user error. Got home and the one i swapped it out for ALSO is defective. Ill now have to make a second trip to the store. Waste of time and $$$$$ for this product very disappointed

avis.titre: There is no way this is for acne skin
avis.texte: Despite the description, I found this incredibly oily after application. I have to admit it looked nice. I found myself breaking out with cystic bumps within days of wearing it, especially if I ended up sweating, giving away the tube before I even finish it.
This sunscreen moisturizing snd leaves skin dewy and glowy. Its great for no make up days under make up. Does not pill. Probably not for oily skin but works great for me as my skin tends to be dry.

As an acne prone, sentive combo skin person I've had to trial and error my way through many sunscreens. I've tried Elta MD, Supergoop, La Roche Posay, etc and had issues with all of them. I've really been loving this one from bubble. There is no niacinamide which is hard to find in a mineral sunscreen if you're senstive to it like I am. There is no "sunscreen" smell or even a smell in general. It's tinted a fair amount, I have a light to medium complextion and it blends in with my skin perfectly. I did experience pilling once due to the other products in my routine but have not since switching some products to PM. My only concern is that oily/greasy factor as I haven't gotten to experience it in the summer heat yet. I'm hoping using this with my Danessa Myricks blurring balm will help maintain oilyness.

This sunscreen is just okay. It takes a while to rub in but sets down nicely and leaves a healthy glow on the skin. One caveat: I bought this on sale on 1/24/26 and have been usng it since. I've always noticed a strange smell, and that it left my skin a little itchy (and my skin is NOT sensitive). Today I happened to check the box and saw the expiration date of 1/2026. Super disappointed that Ulta sold an expired product!! Shameful. From now on, if I buy a product on sale from Ulta, I'll be checking the expiration date as soon as I get it.
This is my 3rd time repurchasing. I wear this everyday! Its basically become my skin tint and i just pop on concealer where needed, throw on some cheek products, etc and go!
Its in my EVERY DAY skincare routine ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️im in love♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️

I'm fair skinned and worried this would be too orange and it was not. I have freckles and my skin is luckily not prone to issues so I just wanted something light but with a touch of coverage without erasing my freckles. I absolutely love this product. It's a new holy grail.
Extremely dark and looks orange on my dair skin. Also is very oily. Probably would work better for someone with darker more dry skin.

This is probably my favorite tinted sunscreen! It doesn't leave my skin greasy in anyway. It is super hydrating and works super well. This product has lasted me over 6 months and there is still a lot left in it. It is definitely worth the price! I would definitely recommend this!
This OK, but it is a waste of money because it leaves a cast on your skin.
I absolutely LOVE this product. It gives me the perfect glow and skin tint!

I found my favorite sunscreen! I tend to be oily, and this is not greasy at all. Wears well under makeup. It's all mineral, so it doesn't sting my eyes. I am fair and cool, so often tinted sunscreens make me look orange. This one completely disappears. My only complaint is that when I've purchased it both online and in store, I've gotten tubes with less than 6 months left before it expires. I'd love to stock up when it's on sale, but I can't do that if it's soon to expire.

avis.titre: Ehhh not my fave bubble product
avis.texte: So I loved this a t first but one day I went to a store and tried on a sweatshirt and it came off on the sweatshirt!! It doesn't stay on your face super well and it is a good formula but I just wish it absorbed into the skin more instead of feeling like a foundation
This product is horrible. It's greasy, doesn't dry, looks shiny and the tint is nonexistent. I would not recommend this product. It's also not worth the money.

I like the formula, as it dries well and doesn't leave a heavy/sticky feeling. However, I bought this before a trip and all I can see is that "LOOK HOW ORANGE YOU LOOK" scene from a certain show in every pic I wore it in. I'm not even that pale!
I use this moisturizer with and without makeup, it gives very light coverage but my skin feels very hydrated after. I also like that it's a mineral spf
Love the way the product has a pump dispenser. The tint is a nice subtle color. Clean ingredients. Would get again.

Okay, so this review may be a little bias if you see it that way, because I'm a supergoop girl all the way. I have been using supergoop matte screen tinted mineral spf for about 3/4 years now but decided to try Bubble because it was cheap and I wasn't feeling like spending $40 on supergoop that day. I wanted to love it, but I just couldn't use it. First of all, how dare they call it a "mineral" spf, It has the texture of cheap drug store mousse foundation. Second, some reviews say that the color adjusts on your skin over time, but that was not the case for me, and I'm not pale to begin with. My face was a shade darker than the rest of me for the whole day and it never adjusted. Third, the quality is just not there. I felt greasy with it on, and it was very tacky/sticky the whole time i had it on. I will definitely be sticking with Supergoop from now on.

I didn't like this product but I'm trying to use it so my money isnt wasted. The smell is awful. Smells like old makeup. Then the way it sits on my skin is uncomfortable and greasy. It's also kind of hard to spread it evenly across the face with your fingers at first because of the consistency.

avis.titre: This stuff is magic in a cute green tube. Seriously.
avis.texte: I meant what I said. It feels really lovely on the skin, I'm sure it does the job as far as sunscreen is concerned, too, but equally as important? It blurs. My skin looks fantastic.

I do actually love this product. I bought it before my bachelorette and had a very uneven fake tan on my face. When I put this on, it even it out a lot and matched perfectly with my skin tone color. The only problem that I did have was that it was very splotchy and you would only notice it once you left the house. I switched over to the kylie slip tint and I would 100% recommend it more than this product.

This product advertises itself as a non white cast sunscreen, which doesn't seem to be true. It contains 15% zinc oxide which does cause a white cast. Overall it is an ok sunscreen but I just don't like how it says it's a non white cast sunscreen event though it is. On the skin it feels heavy and oiler than your average sunscreen.
I have a medium skin tone and it leaves a good finish applies smoothly and very minimal white cast.

avis.titre: Wanted to love this but fell short
avis.texte: I have seen so many people recommend this product, so i wanted to love it! For a long time, i had been using the la roche posay tinted sunscreen but heard this one wad better. In comparison, i believe the la roche posay to be better for combo oily skin with acne/hyperpigmentation. This one just looks super greasy, i have tried using with/without moisturizer under. It stings when i wear. In comparison with la roche posay specifically, this tinted sunscreen has zero coverage, whereas LRP has light coverage for acne spots/marks and hyperpigmentation. Wanted to love bubble but im afraid its a no for me.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again!
avis.texte: I love everything about this Tinted Mineral Sunscreen. The color is universal, no smell, and covers evenly.

definitely not lightweight on my skin, it feels like putting on a heavy moisturizing cream so I was worried about my oily skin. It takes a few minutes to dry/set down, but when it does it is great! It keeps my oily skin matte/satin all day which I was not expecting! my last holy grail tinted SPF was discontinued and this is replacing it!

My daughter introduced me to this product and I was instantly hooked! I don't wear foundation very often so this is a perfect way to add a tint of color to even out my complexion. It's lightweight and adds a nice glow as well. Being a sunscreen is the icing on the cake! If you want a more matte finish, simply add a little more setting powder (I wanted glowly this day). Great for both teens and adults alike!

I knew after my first use that this sunscreen was going to become my main. It comes out a dark tan but appears to have some sort of pH shade change? I say this for two reasons. When i spot tested on my arm, it became a lighter color as i was rubbing it in. A different time, i had applied it after using a moisturizer that i was testing with this sunscreen and it started turing an orange/yellow tinge. So, I definitely am under the impression the sunscreen is designed to react and change shade! But it performs soooo good. My makeup sticks and hasnt creased at all, and i havent needed any primer. Importantly, no sun burns! It feels amazing on my skin and has an skin-evening quality if you are looking for a natural look. My skin doesnt get greasy or dry. I will forever be using this sunscreen.
I've only used this for a few days, but already it's become my favorite tinted sunscreen! Not greasy or heavy and works well with my current moisturizer.

I purchased this one and the regular spf in the yellow bottle and I like this one better. It feels good on my skin, easy to blend. Has a pretty glow but not greasy. Hasnt caused breakouts. Its not a full coverage product by any means and you will need to reapply specially if you want to keep the SPF benefits (as you should anyway because of the spf). No smell. Easy to blend. All my other makeup blends very well on top and looks good not streaky.
Great spf i love it to pieces would totally recommend bubble skincare to anyone and everyone
This is not reslly suitable for anyone that has oily/combo or even medium or light skin tones. It leaves an orange-brown film. However, if you have dry leaning dark skin, this might work for you

I have never in my ten years of purchasing every sunscreen known to man liked a mineral sunscreen. I have maturing combination skin and I am a makeup junkie so I need a sunscreen that works for my skin type and wears well under makeup. I have a korean sunscreen favorite that does that, but I wanted a mire easily accessible option. THIS IS IT. I don't know what magic is in this, but my skin looks smooth, my makeup applies flawlessly, and has never looked better. I am amazed. This is the only product I've changed in my routine and so far it has worked with every kind of foundation I have.
I think this is a really good sunscreen and gives a nice tint to your face, but it does look a little greasy
Amazing prodcut that is glowy and amazingly priced! Its not very dark and i love that! Yoi also dont feel it on your face at all!

I have very sesitive, acne prone skin and this sunscreen has checked every box for me! I was nervous to add a new product to my routine, but im SO happy i did. I almost never write reviews, but this sunscreen deserves five stars. The tint can be blended into even the fairest of skin (hi, redhead here). I thought it would be too dark, but i just make sure to blend it doen my neck and at my hairline. It gives a nice bronzey glow but doesnt look orange/too dark. No new breakouts which is the biggest win!
This tinted sunscreen is really not for me. It is so thick and left a rash on my skin. I really don't like it
This tinted sunscreen is really not for me. It is so thick and left a rash on my skin. I really don't like it

I use this all the time mixed with another (white) sunscreen to make it lighter since it is a little too dark of a tint for me. I have pretty oily skin but it can definitely be greasy sometimes you just have to rub it in a lot
It seems dark for me, but when i use it, it is not. I love how well it evens out my skin tone and is not shiny or greasy. I feel good about going out without makeup. Highly recommend.

avis.titre: Good formula but a deep tint
avis.texte: The tint is way too dark and does not work for all skin tones. I have blond hair and fair skin, and it stains my hair line and does not blend in evenly. I can't wear it on its own, but my foundation layers on it beautifully. It doesn't get oily and hasn't broken me out- and I have oily and acne prone skin. I chose this sunscreen because the ingredients were the best I could find that was still pregnancy safe! It does not come off easily with a regular face wash and I have to use micellar water. Overall, I would not buy again unless they come out with an untinted version.
Love these but you have to reply it if you use it for sunscreen

avis.titre: Works for 2 different skin types in my family
avis.texte: I give this a 4.5 but for some reason I could only do 4 or 5 stars. My daughter and I both use this. Obviously we have very different skin types and we both love it. It isn't heavy and dries fast for us. It bends well and doesn't rub off on our clothes. My only complaint is I wish it evened my skin tone a bit more. I am very freckly though so not many products work unless I want thick layers of foundation and concealer. My daughter feels it evens her skin tone just fine.

Do not buy if you live in a humid climate, going to sweat, or going to be wet. You have been warned! It burns so badly if even a tiny bit gets near eyes! I can not emphasize enough the pain that occurred when 1 drop of water ran into my eye. It felt like lava had run into my eye it was that bad! This was the only product I had on my face. I bought this thinking I could use it to even out my skin tone and have the sunscreen in one. The tint doesn't actually do anything to even out skin tone (I'm light to medium). The texture is thick and it takes at least 30 minutes to dry down all the way. I don't have that kind of time just to wait for sunscreen to dry. This just isn't for me.

I want to love this so much. I've used half the tube because i like the coverage and it does it's job. But EVERY SINGLE TIME i wear it, i break out. Just a few hours after application and for a day or two after. So maybe if you don't have skin orone to breakouts, it will work for you.

avis.titre: Great but not my ideal SPF
avis.texte: I love the formula and ingredients however, I do find it can feel heavy especially underneath of makeup. I noticed that my makeup doesn't last as long when I wear it either, but still can get 5ish hours of good wear. While it doesn't leave a white cast, I sometimes find the tint to be too much when I wear it on its own--I am NC12 in MAC for reference. This also has a sheen, like little fine glitter particles. I personally prefer a more natural finish on my skin and find it can look like I'm sweaty (when worn alone, without makeup). However, if you are looking for a dewy finish SPF, this is it. I will also add that it takes a bit to blend in, not bad at all, but I just noticed the difference when comparing it to my Korean chemical SPFs. Overall a good choice for those looking for a mineral, dewy SPF that has no white cast.

I have tried several different tinted sunscreens. I always run into an issue where its still purple, or its too orange, or its super greasy and I break out. THIS product has been amazing! Its in an awesome pump container so there is no messy spilling. It rubs in super easily with my normal skincare. I personally haven't experienced any pilling. It blends into my skin without white cast or an organge hue (black girly here btw). Its not greasy at all and my skin has yet to break out. I love it!

Had high hopes for this, since my usual holy grail face sunscreen had it's formula changed. I am not super fair, but this really looked orange on me. The texture was okay, a little tacky on the skin, probably would not work under makeup. Plus side, I have super sensitive skin and this did not break me out!

Jen Phelps recommended this on a survey she did on mineral sunscreens! This sunscreen does great with makeup application or wear by itself'. No white cast! Doesn't break me out or cause any allergic reaction! Jen was spot on with her evaluation! Plus it's so affordable! If you go in the water you will need a water resistant sunscreen for protection from UVA/UVB rays! Hope this help! I have mature skin and this is my favorite after Using sun protection my entire adult life!

Youtuber Jen Phelps recommended this product as one of her favs, she was right, so glad I tried this tinted sun screen. it is a light formula, spreads easily and evenly without burning my eyes. layers perfectly under makeup. I will definitely be buying again.

I am southeast Asian with a light-medium skintone. This tinted sunscreen blended in beautifully and I was so impressed that it wasn't as greasy as other tinted sunscreens I've tried in the past, nor did it dry down to a pastey finish. I can see this not working for darker complexions but fortunately it worked for my skin tone.

I have semi-sensitive skin (can use many mainstream items if they don't have heavy fragrance) and fair skin: this product was a decent color match and i love how quickly it blends, but after many weeks or trialling it, i can confirm the skin does get to feeling a slight burning sensation (not painful like an allergic reaction, but uncomfortable like you can feel your skin just existing) when sweating (just BARELY sweating) and/or in direct sun or heat. if you're sweating AND out in the sun — kiss your face goodbye, as it became such a strange feeling.
I really REALLY love this sunscreen. It's the only one I've found works well with my skin tone. And it doesn't feel too greasy or too dry, just right.

Really impressed with the formula. Lightweight and moisturizing. I break out with chemical sunscreens including korean. I tolerate most mineral sunscreens even though they are drying or super greasy. This wears like a chemical sunscren (thin and hydrating) but does not break me out. I hope they never discontinue this formuala. Best sunscreen ive ever tried (and I've tried dozens).

avis.titre: Good for the right skin tone
avis.texte: I would say if you are light skinned that's able to tan or you are natural tan this will work but anything lighter or darker than this will not work. You have to do 2 thin layers with this. Honestly this works as well as some 40 dollar ones I tried.

This has Phenoxyethanol. If you want to get pregnant dont use anything with this chemical. It cause alot of health issues. No reason to have this . Shame on Bubble! Also they only use 12% zinc it should be 15% at least gor a true 30 spf.

avis.titre: Too dark/greasy on fair oily skin
avis.texte: When using the recommended 2-4 pumps, this sunscreen is too dark on me and very greasy. It's a shame because I love Bubble and I was hoping this could be a sunscreen I could wear without makeup.

I have tried most spf that are available to buy in store and this is one of my favorites far. If you are looking for -dewy -lightly tinted -mineral You will love ! I am acne prone and prefer mineral and i love this one great mineral protection and it does not pill under makeup. On my 3rd bottle !

I wanted something lightweight to wear everyday underneath my makeup but this sunscreen is thick and doesn't settle into the skin as nicely as i was hoping for. I used this product before a workout and it burned my skin as i started to sweat. I wouldn't recommend this to anyone with dry and/or sensitive skin. Bummed because i was super excited to try this brand!
This is the best thing that Bubble has made probably so far!!🫶🏻 I use it every single day!!

avis.titre: Do not be alarmed, also for pale skin!
avis.texte: I am caucasian, ok? Like, Scandanavian. I am from The Netherlands. I got this because of the reviews and I was hoping it would give a little tint so that I don't have to wear makeup all the time. Some reviews said that the company should offer color selection, but it's unnecessary. I'm glad I looked at the pictures, which show someone rubbing it in, and it seems to be dissolving into their skin and skintone. That's exactly what it does. Do not be alarmed when you put this on your hands and you think it's too orange. It's not. After you gently rub it in all over your face and neck, it kind of smoothes out and works with your natural skin tone. It really evens my face and rest of my body out, without looking like I have anything on. I was almost afraid and threw it out, but I'm glad I gave it two more tries. Several people have told me my skin is glowing and I look good since I got this stuff. It does take a second to fall into the skin, but my makeup looks excellent and glowing on top!

I have ohrchaser 4-5 dofferenr "highly-rated" face sunscreens for my face but they have all disappointed me. This one feels perfect! Not too heavy or sticky and doesn't clog my pores or causes breakouts. The light tint is not noticeable and my skin looks so even toned.

avis.titre: Only ok. Good for the beach, not under makeup.
avis.texte: This blended easily with no cast. I let it sit on bare skin for 15 min, went outside and my face felt hotter than any where else. Not a good start. I then applied my skin like, self setting foundation and 20 min later it's still tacky and looks to be sitting semi heavily on top. My normal products that set beautifully all lifted anything underneath when used with this. Used by itself it was a satin finish but 0 coverage that did not fully dry down. I used about a pump and a half for my face and neck. I have dry/normal skin. I will try it with other base items but will most likely return.

avis.titre: Not too bad, not the best…
avis.texte: I like this sunscreen ~ok~. My biggets qualm is that the formula is quite thick and settles on top of the skin rather than really melting or absorbing into the skin. The tint is great for summer. My natural skin tone is quite fair and cool toned, and if i didnt self tan my body this formula would likely be too dark. Ive noticed that towards the end of the day a lone dry spot will disturb the rest of the sunscreen and cause pilling. This definitely becomes an issue when reapplying through the day. There is also quite a bit if color transfer. It doesnt matter if i apply after getting dressed, or wait several minutes after applying to get dressed— the formula ALWAYS transfers. The pigment comes out in the wash fine, so its more of an annoyance than anything. Lastly, adequate coverage for the face and neck is 1/4-1/2tsp (i believe) which is 8-9 pumps of this product from my initial test. The product has a hard time settling in period, especially when using the proper amount. The packaging is cute and mess free for the most part, and the scent is very minimal.
I like this product ive never used like a slin tint before its somehting you have to get used too. But i love this product

As brown skin girl its a miracle for a mineral sunscreen to not leave a white cast. Its comfy on the skin. Has a lot of good skin ingredients. And its not super expensive. I also reapplied it and it didnt make me overly greasy. I do get a little oil peep through occasioanlly but nothing insane. I would say if you have really dry skin, wear a separate moisturizer underneath. Its not enougn moisture on its own for those whos skin crave it. Otherwise i love it and as long as the formula doesnt change i will continue .
Nice skin tint and made skin glowy, but within 4 hours noticed lots of red bumps and spots. Not sure what ingredients made my skin react this way but I do have sensitive oily skin.
Great product for the price.. Many "bad" reviews are subjective so take that in to accoint before you pass up trying this!
This sunscreen would the the best out there if it didnt contain a big pore clogging ingredient Polyglyceryl-3 Diisostearate…please if only they would remove this ingredient 😫.
i love the way this applies and it doesnt burn my eyes like other sunscreens but it makes my face so incredibly dry around my eyes and nose and behind my ears and its so uncomfortable

I wanted to love this so much as it is such an affordable option compared to others. Unfortunately, this product made me break out almost instantly. The coverage and color it adds is beautiful, but it also burns if it gets in your eyes.
Ok it made me break out I thought it was something else but it wasn't it made me have a rash and BAD dry spots but bubble i love your stuff this one is just not me

As someone who has combination and slightly tanned skin, this works well for me. It moisturizes without needing to use too much of the product at once, and lasts. However, this product can become greasy on the skin if left on for too long. Otherwise, there aren't really any cons.

I am fair skinned. I just bought this stuff and love it! The texture isn't oily or greasy. It has a slight dry "stick" feel to it that I wouldn't say is tacky. It isn't gritty. It doesn't seem to pill. I think it would work great under makeup. It goes on sort of white-tinted but soaks/set in without being noticeable on me. The Ulta worker that recommended it to me was hispanic and medium skin toned and he said he wears it and it blends well for him. It feels like a lotion going on.

I am a fair girly, and this feels very good, lightweight, dewy but not oily…my issue is the SHADE RANGE. Its winter currently so im pale af, in the summer ill tan enough for yhis shade to suit me, but i shouldn't have to do all that😩. Yes i can fix it with a lighter concealer BUT once again i shouldnt have to do all that. Wouldn't recommend for people who are fair or dark skin. Has orange undertone to it as well. Would lovely suit someone with medium skin tone.

avis.titre: Good product but not for all skin tones
avis.texte: I really wanted to love this product and have it be part of my daily routine but it didn't work out too well for me. I adore everything about the formula and how smooth it is - there's not stickiness or tackiness whatsoever. My ONLY and yet biggest issue is the color. While it's meant to be a universal shade, as a porcelain / fair shade girl, this product was definitely too orange for me. I hope in the future they consider launching more shades with this formula as Id definitely be open to retrying it!
These products are really helping my 13 year old daughter's acne prone skin. I appreciate that the cost is manageable as well. Thank you!
57 yrs old with angry aging skin and this set has has calmed the storm. Great products at a great price

I wanted to love it and I do love some things about it! It goes on so smoothly and has a light non greasy feel, and doesn't leave any visible cast. Unfortunately, one of the main reasons I use spf is to prevent melasma (skin darkening) on my upper lip. This product immediately feels so heavy only on that spot and makes my pores start to sweat! I end up sweating it off one of the most important parts of my face immediately. I also noticed that when it's really hot and and mixes with my sweat, it makes the sensitive skin under my eyes burn a little. So I'd say, for me it will work for winter when I'm not sweating a lot, but is not ideal for lots of sun and sweat.
It a hydrating, lightly tinted Spf and I love the color it gives.

comparing to a skin color through makeup, I have Bare Minerals "fairly light 03" skin tone.
